name.value: Qualicum Beach Visitor Information and Chamber of Commerce

description.value: The Qualicum Beach Chamber of Commerce has served as the voice of local business since at least the 1920s, acting as the town's primary visitor information hub on the east coast of Vancouver Island. Cycling tourists passing through can use it as a starting point to discover local restaurants, accommodations, shops, and community events. The organization also promotes Qualicum Beach as a tourism destination and maintains an active local business directory.

address.value: 2711 Island Hwy W., Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2C4
